name: Game Drives
description: Open vehicles, early starts and a guide who knows where the animals were yesterday. The foundation of most safari days.

name: Walking Safari
description: On foot with a guide and an armed scout. Slower, quieter, and a completely different relationship to the ground.

name: Night Drives
description: After dark with a spotlight, when the cats are moving and the smaller nocturnal animals appear. Permitted on private land where the parks do not allow it.

name: Gorilla Trekking
description: Permits are capped daily and booked months ahead. One hour with a habituated family, however long the climb takes.

name: Rhino Tracking
description: On foot with a conservancy monitoring team who know each animal individually.

name: Birdwatching
description: Rewarding on every itinerary here, and the reason some guests extend. Guides carry the books.

name: Marine Wildlife
description: Turtles, rays, sea lions and whatever the season brings. Watched from the water rather than a boat rail.

name: Polar Wildlife
description: Bears on the ice edge, walrus haul-outs and bird cliffs. Entirely dependent on where the ice sits that year.

name: Snorkelling
description: Off the beach or off the boat, on reefs that begin in waist-deep water.

name: Diving
description: Certified diving on walls and drop-offs, with equipment and guiding arranged in advance.

name: Canoeing
description: Poled through papyrus in a dugout, at water level and in near silence. The only way to see the delta's small things.

name: Sailing
description: Traditional rig, sailed rather than motored, usually timed for the end of the day.

name: Zodiac Cruising
description: Inflatables launched from the ship to reach coastlines and ice that the vessel itself cannot approach.

name: Hiking & Trekking
description: Anything from an hour to a full day, matched to what you actually want rather than a fixed programme.

name: Horse Riding
description: Horses suited to your standard, among plains game that ignores a horse entirely.

name: Hot Air Ballooning
description: One morning aloft at dawn, weather permitting, landing to breakfast on the grass.

name: Scenic Flights
description: Helicopter or light aircraft, flown low and routed for the view rather than the destination.

name: Desert Exploration
description: Dunes, dry riverbeds and gravel plains, on foot and by vehicle, usually at either end of the day.

name: Cultural Visits
description: Arranged through people we work with directly, on terms the community sets.

name: Festivals & Ceremony
description: Timed into an itinerary where the dates allow, at courtyards that are still local rather than ticketed.

name: Temples & Monasteries
description: Opened privately where possible, which usually means before the doors open to everyone else.

name: Private Dining
description: Your own chef, and meals wherever they make sense — a riverbed, a deck, the middle of a plain.
